result.markdown:
The best payroll software depends on your business size, whether you have employees or contractors, and which accounting software you use.

For a small business, I'd prioritise five things\:

- **Automatic tax calculations** – PAYE, National Insurance and pension deductions.
- **HMRC submissions** – automatic Real Time Information (RTI) reporting.
- **Pension integration** – workplace pension contributions and auto-enrolment.
- **Employee payslips** – ideally accessible online.
- **Good value** – no unnecessarily expensive monthly subscriptions.

If you're running a small business in the UK, I'd look at UK payroll providers rather than US-focused options such as Gusto.

search_results.description: The article reviews payroll platforms for small businesses in 2026, assessing features, pricing, usability, integrations, documentation, and customer support. Gusto is its top dependable choice, combining full-service payroll, tax compliance, benefits, and accounting integrations. Xero stands out for accounting and app integrations, while QuickBooks is recommended for mobile payroll. Paychex suits businesses seeking outsourced HR and benefits administration; Rippling offers flexible, scalable HR, payroll, IT, and expense tools. Remote Payroll supports international hiring and compliance, and Zoho People bundles payroll with a broad HR and business ecosystem. Other picks include PeopleHR for UK SMEs, Patriot Payroll for straightforward value, BambooHR for ease of use, Hourly for time tracking and workers’ compensation, 1st Money for small UK businesses (free for fewer than 10 employees), Breathe HR for simplified HR, and Employment Hero for advanced features. The article also highlights ADP’s payroll and HR services. It advises choosing software based on business size and required features, prioritizing compliance, integrations, transparent pricing, employee self-service, and responsive support.

search_results.title: RUN Powered by ADP software review: Simple and streamlined for small businesses
search_results.description: RUN Powered by ADP is a payroll and HR platform aimed at businesses with fewer than 50 employees. Its four plans range from Essential Payroll, covering payroll, taxes, and compliance, to HR Pro, which adds services such as applicant tracking, learning management, and legal assistance. Pricing is quote-based. The platform offers automated payroll, tax filing, employee self-service, onboarding, reporting, mobile access, reminders, and AI-powered error flagging. Its intuitive interface and clear workflows make it accessible to small businesses without dedicated HR expertise. Support includes 24/7 payroll phone assistance, weekday live chat, and additional HR support on higher tiers, though users report that payroll help can sometimes be slow. Key drawbacks include limited analytics, customization, API access, and integrations, as well as extra costs for add-ons such as time tracking, retirement, workers’ compensation, and health insurance. Overall, RUN is a strong choice for small businesses seeking straightforward payroll and core HR tools, but growing organizations with more complex needs may prefer a more flexible platform.
